title: User Guide of Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A tool for simulating concept drift in data-stream regression research, using CTGAN models trained on real datasets as an 'infinite' synthetic data source for sudden, gradual, and incremental drift scenarios. It trains and samples these generators through SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata, and conditional sampling APIs.
